text: For the moment he only saw one thing about the man; which was the revolver in his hand. “Cray!” exclaimed the Major, staring at him; “did you fire that shot?” “Yes, I did,” retorted the black-haired gentleman hotly; “and so would you in my place. If you were chased everywhere by devils and nearly--” The Major seemed to intervene rather hurriedly. “This is my friend Father Brown,” he said. And then to Brown: “I don’t know whether you’ve met Colonel Cray of the Royal Artillery.” “I have heard of him, of course,” said the priest innocently.
